cc:Work.dc:title: Vladivostok by steamship, 1881–1907
cc:Work.dc:description: Final author map. Dated selected historical connections from https://www.jacar.go.jp/english/exhibition/glossary_en/meijiasia/routes/index.html and https://www.jacar.go.jp/english/exhibition/glossary_en/meijiasia/table/history2.html. Modern coastline; representative city and island-group positions; schematic connecting curves. Geography is vector; text is outlined for portability.
